# Quiet UI Skills (`quiet-ui` + `quiet-evidence` + `quiet-bridge`) v9.0

> 100% first-party, zero-dependency design system and deterministic engineering compiler suite unifying **7 physical delivery mediums (`quiet-ui`)**, **6 calibrated evidence & open-standards SVG compilers (`quiet-evidence`)**, and **audience communication vectors (`quiet-bridge`)** on one 4-theme CSS token palette.

- **v9.0 Multi-Domain Interactive Studio (`6 Domains · 21 Views`):** `quiet-ui-showcase.html` (GitHub Pages: `docs/index.html`)
- **3-Pillar Component Library (`36 Compiled Specimens`):** `docs/bench/evidence-bench.html` (Quiet SVG | Live Apache ECharts + UI/Bridge Controls)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/FrankXLT/quiet-ui-skills
- **Bundled Pillars:** `quiet-ui` (7 Mediums · N0–N4 Morphing Shells) + `quiet-evidence` (Calibrated Plots, Waveforms, Bitfields & Open-Standards Schematics) + `quiet-bridge` (Audience Translation & Plain-English Rationale)
- **License:** Apache 2.0 (Core 3-Pillar Plugin) + MIT (Customizations, Tokens & 100% of Generated UI/SVG Deliverables)

## 1. Installation & Quick Start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/FrankXLT/quiet-ui-skills.git
cd quiet-ui-skills
./install.sh
```

Installs the native **Quiet UI Skills** plugin into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/quiet-ui-skills/` and standalone skills into `~/.agents/skills/{quiet-ui,quiet-evidence,quiet-bridge}/`.

### Customize in 60 Seconds (`customizations/`)
One manifest (`customizations/<name>/customization.json`) skins UI shells and every compiled SVG schematic simultaneously:
- **`customizations/personal-starter/`**: Full-range blueprint (21 views across 6 domains) for personal research, telemetry, optical viewport HUD, and tactile consoles.
- **`customizations/brand-starter/`**: Product blueprint (17 views across Domains 01–05) for enterprise documentation, workflows, roadmaps, and engineering workspaces.

```bash
python3 customizations/scripts/build_showcase.py customizations/<target>
python3 customizations/scripts/verify_customization.py customizations/<target> --check-immutability
```

## 2. Shared Architectural Contracts (`quiet-ui` + `quiet-evidence` + `quiet-bridge`)

1. **Self-Immutability Lock:** `skills/quiet-ui/`, `skills/quiet-evidence/`, `skills/quiet-bridge/`, `customizations/personal-starter/`, and `customizations/brand-starter/` are strictly read-only during user workflows.
2. **4-Theme CSS Token Cohesion & 4-Way SHA-256 Parity:** All 3 pillars bind surfaces, ink, hairlines, and semantic tints to `tokens/quiet-ui-tokens.css` (`data-theme="white|paper|dark-paper|dark"`, defaulting to `white`), mirrored across `tokens/`, `skills/quiet-ui/tokens/`, and both starter kits.
3. **Fluid 4K Root Scale & 3-Role Font Stack:**
   - Fluid 4K root: `clamp(16px, calc(12.4px + 0.25vw), 22px)` with `11px` hard legibility floor (`--ts-xs`).
   - `--font-sans` (`Inter`, system sans + `tabular-nums`) for navigation, kickers, controls, and headings.
   - `--font-serif` (`Newsreader`, `Georgia`) strictly for monograph prose and display H1.
   - `--font-mono` (`JetBrains Mono`, `ui-monospace`) strictly for machine literals, telemetry readouts, register bits, and code.
4. **Concentric Border-Radius Math & NASA Human-Factors Invariants:**
   - `--radius-inner: max(0px, calc(var(--radius-card, 8px) - var(--inset-pad, 4px)))` across `auto|sharp|subtle|rounded|soft`.
   - NASA-STD-3001/HIDH rules: telemetry vs effectors separation, `CMD`/`ACT` feedback, 2-step guarded actuation (`ARM` -> `EXECUTE`), quiet cockpit nominal neutrality, and `STALE` flags.

## 3. Pillar 1 — `quiet-ui` (7 Delivery Mediums)

- `M1` — Paper & Ink Print Sheets (unboxed, `@media print` optimized)
- `M2` — Editorial Web Monographs, RFCs & Two-Column Proof Layouts (`72ch`)
- `M3` — Stateful Web Workbenches, Fleet Grids & Split-Pane Planners
- `M4` — Walk-Up POI Terminals & Guarded Industrial SCADA Consoles
- `M5` — 10-Foot Ambient Wall Displays (`>= 32px` KPIs, zero decorative chrome)
- `M6` — Collimated Optical HUDs (`>= 65%` unobstructed central keep-out zone)
- `M7` — Transparent Smart-Glass Overlays (`>= 7.0:1` peripheral smoked scrims)

## 4. Pillar 2 — `quiet-evidence` (6 Deterministic Evidence Modalities)

- **Modalities (`compile_evidence.py`):** `scalars` (linear range/threshold gauges & compact metrics), `tables` (Booktabs alignment & collapsible mobile disclosures), `waveforms` (linked clinical/HIL/reflection multi-channel scopes), `plots` (calibrated Cartesian/calibration curves, stacked bars, dumbbell, forest with pooled diamonds, `gantt` schedules, and `heatmap` matrices with `1–2–5` ticks and `svg_knockout_label`), `bitfields` (32/64-bit MSB-left hardware register strips + decode table), and `schematics` (`pid`, `pipeline`, `bus`, `interlock`, `er_lineage`, plus clean-room open standards `sequence` [`ITU-T Z.120`], `n2_matrix` [`NASA SP-2016-6105`], and `fault_tree` [`NRC NUREG-0492`]).
